skills.name: jarvis-box
skills.risk: critical: configuration, recovery, identity, license, and service lifecycle mutations
transitions: resolve release -> identify owner -> save -> activate -> effective-state and behavior proof
cross_repo: Private source owns runtime implementation and release; public skill owns customer operation and must not claim source changes.

skills.name: jarvis-box-init
skills.risk: high: can falsely promote an unverified deployment to ready
transitions: identity and version preflight -> read-only deployment -> discovery -> authorized ingress -> Task/Run -> writeback -> terminal/cleanup
mechanical_controls: executed-pass: depth audit routes init to onboarding
observed-not-executed: real customer ingress requires an authorized target
cross_repo: Company Runtime Foundation owns Company discovery and jobs; this skill consumes its doctor and preserves the boundary.

skills.name: jarvis-box-doctor
skills.risk: normal: read-only diagnosis; risk is misleading stage attribution
transitions: resolve target -> collect typed evidence -> separate stages -> report PASS/FAIL/WARN/PENDING -> no mutation
mechanical_controls: observed-not-executed: deployment-specific doctor requires a real target
cross_repo: Runtime Foundation health is checked only through the customer-owned command; no Company repo inspection or mutation.

skills.name: jarvis-box-monitor
skills.risk: normal: read-only reporting; risk is sampling or analysis initiation misrepresented as observation
transitions: declare window/population -> inspect typed states -> separate execution/delivery/cleanup -> report next actions without mutation
mechanical_controls: observed-not-executed: live task population requires a deployment
cross_repo: Provider delivery metrics are read through Jarvis Box; provider truth and downstream delivery remain external observations.

skills.name: jarvis-box-release-maintainer
skills.risk: high: can violate the public/private source boundary or publish stale customer contracts
transitions: classify docs/skills/source -> edit public owner -> update manifest/package -> audit -> branch/PR
cross_repo: Implementation handoff goes to canonical private source; public proof ends at reviewed docs/skill PR and release-qualified artifacts.
